Info: TEMP shows one decimal in metric (the figure shows whole degrees), battery as a percent from the log
Info: PRESSURE - surface 1013 mbar and now from depth (salt water), not the logged barometer
Gauge: STOPWATCH shows the dive time - a log records no stopwatch start or reset; the stopwatch title is always green (running)
